name: designed 1
about: A friendly American man in his early thirties from a small Midwestern town, telling a true story to a friend over coffee. Warm, clear, relaxed baritone with an easy smile in the voice, natural conversational American English, sincere and grounded, never announcer-like or salesy.

name: designed 3
about: A likable small-town American guy around thirty-two, the one everybody in town knows. Smooth medium-low voice, a little husky, unhurried storytelling pace with natural pauses, quietly emotional on the sad parts, plain Midwestern accent.
